Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Thomas George Lyon-Bowes, Lord Glamis’s father as John Bowes (9th Earl) instead of the correct father, Thomas Lyon-Bowes, 11th Earl, and inferred country based on titles/contexts rather than verifying nationality. This incorrect parent identification and reliance on peerage/title cues led to concluding “Scotland” first and later “England” (from a marriage record) instead of the correct “British,” and the error originated at Step 3.
